page.notes: Greek words are the least certain readings. Κεμμήλιον[?] is read from a small, heavy print and may be misread. Τῇ ἀληθείᾳ πάντα συνᾴδει[?] has accents that are hard to make out. The word quô has a circumflex that may be a printing variant. The final line runs into the right edge and is partly obscured by the scan's edge shadow.
